title: Cartwise Rewards Points Redemption — Desk Guidance
content:
Whole blocks are the only unit in which Cartwise Rewards points pay toward an order, and the order's item subtotal sets how far they may go.

## The rule the desk applies

Points are redeemed in whole blocks of the tier's points per block, each worth the tier's block value, at least the tier's fewest blocks per order, and for no more than the tier's percentage of the order's item subtotal. Points apply after Cartwise+ credit on the same order. Redemption is allowed only while the account is active. Points redeemed on an order canceled before shopping are restored once. Points never pay alcohol lines, and pay delivery and service fees only where the tier allows points to pay those fees.

## The same rule, point by point

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| In what units are points used? | Whole blocks only; part of a block is never redeemed |
| How few blocks may one order take? | No fewer than the tier's fewest blocks per order |
| How much of an order may points pay? | No more than the tier's percentage of that order's item subtotal |
| Where do points fall against Cartwise+ credit on the same order? | Points apply after the Cartwise+ credit |
| What may points not pay? | Alcohol lines, at every tier; delivery and service fees, unless the tier allows points to pay them |
| When may points be redeemed at all? | Only while the Cartwise Rewards account is active, as the company's record of that account shows before the redemption |
| What if the order is canceled before shopping? | The points redeemed on it are restored, once |

## Worked limits (hypothetical inputs)

The inputs below are hypothetical: a tier with 1000 points per block, a block value of $10.00, at least 1 block per order and a limit of 50% of the item subtotal.

| Item subtotal | Most points may pay | Whole blocks within that limit | Can points be used? |
|---|---|---|---|
| $87.40 | $43.70 | 4 blocks (4000 points, $40.00) | Yes, from 1 to 4 blocks |
| $20.00 | $10.00 | 1 block (1000 points, $10.00) | Yes, 1 block — the limit is met exactly, which is within "no more than" |
| $19.98 | $9.99 | none | No — even the fewest blocks per order would exceed the limit |

## Restoration, hypothetical

A member redeems 3 blocks on an order that is then canceled before shopping (hypothetical). The 3000 points redeemed on that order come back to the balance, and that redemption is restored once only.

## Basis notes

- The account's status governs redemption: an account that is enrolled but not yet active, suspended or closed may not redeem.
- The percentage limit is measured on the order's item subtotal, not on the order total.
- Whether points may pay delivery and service fees is a matter of tier; alcohol lines may never be paid with points.
